name: Query Data Source
description: Query a data source with a specified filter. [See the documentation](https://developers.notion.com/reference/query-a-data-source)

configurable_props.name: dataSourceId
configurable_props.label: Data Source ID
configurable_props.description: Select a data source or provide a data source ID

configurable_props.name: filter
configurable_props.label: Filter (query)
configurable_props.description: The filter to apply, as a JSON-stringified object. [See the documentation for available filters](https://developers.notion.com/reference/filter-data-source-entries). Example: `{ "property": "Name", "title": { "contains": "title to search for" } }`

configurable_props.name: sorts
configurable_props.label: Sorts
configurable_props.description: The sort order for the query. [See the documentation for available sorts](https://developers.notion.com/reference/sort-data-source-entries). Example: `[ { "property": "Name", "direction": "ascending" } ]`
